title: Sign in
subtitle: Sign in to send and manage your transfers.
passwordRule: At least {{count}} characters. A long passphrase is easier to remember and harder to guess.
sessionExpired: The sign-in attempt expired. Enter your email and password again.
otpHint: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for this account.
recoveryTitle: Sign in with a recovery code
recoveryHint: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on two-factor authentication. Each code works only once.
recoveryFormat: Format: xxxx-xxxx-xxxx. Uppercase or lowercase does not matter.
recoveryConfirmHint: Tick the box above to confirm you saved the codes, then continue.
enrollDescription: Your account requires two-factor authentication. Set it up now to finish signing in.

enroll.step1Body: Use any app that supports one-time codes (TOTP), for example Aegis, 2FAS, Google Authenticator or a password manager.
enroll.manualKey: Cannot scan the code? Enter this key in the app:
enroll.step3Title: 3. Enter the 6-digit code shown by the app

enrollDoneDescription: Keep these recovery codes safe: they are the only way in if you lose your authenticator.
lowCodesBody: Generate a new set from your profile once you are signed in, so you are not locked out later.
lowCodesNone: You have no recovery codes left. Generate a new set from your profile right after signing in.
forgotDescription: Enter your account email. If it exists, we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotSentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, we have sent a link to reset the password. The link expires after a short time (30 minutes by default) and works once.
forgotSentSpam: Nothing in your inbox? Look in the spam folder and wait a minute or two.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: For your security, all your devices will be signed out. Two-factor authentication stays active.
reset.invalidBody: This reset link is missing, has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
reset.doneBody: Your password has been changed and you were signed out everywhere. Sign in with the new password; you will still need your two-factor code.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.description: Set your password to activate the account. The link in your email is valid for 72 hours.
welcome.invalidBody: This welcome link is missing, has expired or was already used.
welcome.invalidHelp: If you have not set a password yet, ask the administrator to send you a new invitation, or use “Forgot your password?” on the sign-in page.
welcome.doneBody: Your password is set. You can sign in now.

errors.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, such as name@example.com.
errors.domainInvalid: Enter a domain such as example.com, without https:// or a path.
errors.subdomainInvalid: Use only letters, numbers and hyphens, for example “files”.
errors.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.locked: Too many failed attempts. Sign-in is locked for now.
